# Jiuding Radiator — Tianjin Jiuding Yangguang HVAC Co., Ltd.

> Family-run manufacturer of steel heating radiators, established 2002 in Ninghe District, Tianjin, China. Product families: designer welded radiators, steel panel radiators (Type 11/21/22/33), steel column radiators (2/3/4-column), towel-rail radiators, and copper-aluminium radiators. Products serve residential and commercial heating across Europe, Russia, and Central Asia (including Mongolia). OEM / ODM supported. Official website: https://jdradiator.com

## Company

- Legal name: Tianjin Jiuding Yangguang HVAC Co., Ltd. (天津市九鼎阳光暖通有限公司)
- Brands: Jiuding Radiator / 九鼎散热器, Montrler, ASHAP
- Established: 2002
- Location: No.9, Wuwei Road, Economic Development Zone, Ninghe District, Tianjin, China
- Materials: cold-rolled / low-carbon steel, and copper-tube + aluminium-fin bimetal
- Markets served: Europe, Russia, Central Asia, and Mongolia

## Certifications (held)

- CE — Declarations of Performance under EU Construction Products Regulation (EU) No. 305/2011, assessed to harmonised standard EN 442-1 by notified body HEATEST s.r.o. (NB 2693)
- ISO 9001:2015 (quality management) and ISO 14001:2015 (environmental management)
- UKCA — steel column radiators, supported by BSRIA test reporting
- REACH — SVHC-compliant (SGS)
- Reaction-to-fire class A1 for CE-certified steel products
